stories.title: Travel plans? Here's what to know as measles exposures reach trains and games
stories.summary: Measles is traveling, with outbreaks in Pennsylvania, Ohio and New York, and exposures on transportation and in sports. What should you know before getting on a plane or train?

stories.title: Massachusetts residents compete to be the 'Voice of Logan' airport
stories.summary: A contest is giving Massachusetts residents a chance to become the new voice of Boston Logan International Airport. With thousands of entries, the competition is wicked steep.

stories.title: They were promised protection. Instead, these kids with disabilities died in foster care
stories.summary: Disabled kids make up the largest group in foster care. They have the worst outcomes. They stay in foster care longest. They're the most likely to die.

stories.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
stories.summary: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

stories.title: Police questioning can shape a sexual assault case. Their approach is often wrong
stories.summary: The Cornell lawsuit filed by a woman alleging a brutal rape raises questions on how police handle such cases. The majority of police lack adequate training on trauma-informed approaches, experts say.

stories.title: Drugs are widely used to sedate dementia patients. Her sons wanted to keep her off them
stories.summary: Potent sedating medications are often used on agitated people with dementia in long-term care facilities despite federal efforts to discourage them. A clash over whether to drug a Michigan woman illuminates the wrenching decisions families and guardians face.
